description: Intact twin of compat_rebuilt_xref.pdf (issue #33 / PDF-86). Emitted by gen_format_compat_corpus.py::gen_rebuilt_xref() from the SAME doc.save() call, captured before the xref damage transform is applied — so it is an independent reference for what a correct reconstruction of the damaged file must recover. Regenerating the corpus reproduces compat_rebuilt_xref.pdf byte-for-byte (verified), which is what makes this file that fixture's genuine pristine ancestor rather than a lookalike.
